Problem Description
: Daily losses of SCB and OCPP communication.
Troubleshooting

Since the connection is intermittently interrupted, I suspect the signal strength may be low. However, as other chargers in the fleet are functioning properly, we can likely rule out this possibility.
I will need to check the charger via SSH access to verify the configurations when it is online on the SCB.
Could you please try rebooting it once, or let us know when it comes back online? We will also monitor it on our end.
For future reference, your case number is
0402835
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
